name: io.agora.agoraeducore.core.internal.launch.AgoraEduSDKInit
description: When the app starts with Agora Education Core 2.8.53–2.8.61.101, this provider prepares the SDK settings, messages, logs, and crash reporting for classroom features.
disableEffect: That SDK version will miss its automatic startup initialization, which can prevent classroom features from starting correctly.
